text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report outlines the results of an investigation to reduce the speed limit on Erie Street from 50 km/h to 30 km/h, between Falstaff Avenue and Maple Leaf Drive. The analysis indicates that the criteria to reduce the speed limit to 30 km/h were not satisfied.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 30 km/h on Erie Street, between Falstaff Avenue and Maple Leaf Drive.
